newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-LEEDS' MOLENAAR SUES FOR PAYMENT FROM VOLENDAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEEDS' MOLENAAR SUES FOR PAYMENT FROM VOLENDAM.

text.p: Leeds United defender Robert Molenaar has asked an arbitration tribunal of the Dutch Soccer Union to rule in his claim for 800,000 guilders ($406,000) from his former employer, Dutch first division side Volendam.
Molenaar says he and Volendam had agreed the payment, which was part of the transfer fee Leeds paid the Dutch side when he moved to England last season.
Volendam denies the existence of any such an agreement.
"Molenaar has made it an arbitration case. The hearing has taken place and I expect a ruling in the second half of July," Volendam chairman Wim Westendorp said.
